name: MJB Development Rules & Workflow
description: MASTER workflow rule. Defines the 5-step execution workflow (Plan → Code → Review → Test → Summary), Subagent-First Policy, Task Classification (Type A: field-only vs Type B: logic change), and the mandatory PRE-EXECUTION GATE (skill lookup + subagent lookup + no-wandering rule). Read this FIRST for any Odoo task.

name: Coding Style
description: General coding style rules: imports at top (stdlib → third-party → local), naming conventions, indentation, and code formatting standards. Apply when writing or reviewing any code.

name: Security Guidelines
description: Mandatory pre-commit security checklist: no hardcoded secrets, input validation, SQL injection prevention (parameterized queries), XSS prevention, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and safe error messages. Apply to every commit.

name: DN Module Standards
description: Standards for Odoo modules: module prefix, author, and Odoo version are read from .agents/.env.local (keys: MODULE_PREFIX, AUTHOR, ODOO_VERSION). Enforces one-model-per-file (py + xml), manifest defaults (license LGPL-3, no website, free module), and complete English summary, description, documentation, and asset metadata.
